question: Which of the following is NOT a pesticide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Homicide**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Types of Pesticides - 
 
• According to the type of pest they kill, there are different types of pesticides -
 
 
• INSECTICIDES - kills insects like cockroaches.
 
• RODENTICIDES - kills rodents like rats and mice 
 
• HERBICIDES - kills unwanted plants in the fields
 
• BACTERICIDES - kills disease-causing bacteria 
 
• FUNGICIDES - kills disease-causing fungus
 
• LARVICIDES - kills larvae of different mosquitoes like dengue, malaria growing in fields or homes.
 
 
 
• **Hence Homicide is NOT pesticide.**
 
• **Homicide **occurs when a person kills another person.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pesticides are chemical compounds used to combat pests such as insects, rodents (like rats), fungi, and parasitic plants (weeds). 
 
• The pesticide consists of the word 'pest' (a destructive insect or another animal that attacks crops, food, livestock, etc) thus meaning, any substance or a mixture of substances whose aim is to destroy or control the impact of any pest.
